newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Tallinn bourse ends mixed after quiet day.
newsitem.headline: Tallinn bourse ends mixed after quiet day.

text.p: Estonian shares closed mixed on Monday after rising in early trade but prices were weighed down by a bout of selling in the afternoon session, dealers said.
Total volumes on the official list reached 34.7 million kroons.
"Stocks tried to go higher but the selling pressure dragged some of them down," one dealer said.
The day's winner was Savings Bank with 10.9 million kroons of shares changing hands. The stock closed 3.25 lower at 102 kroons.
"Savings Bank's price was stable to higher most of the day but the sale of one large block just before the close brought the price down," a dealer said.
Forekspank performed well, gaining 1.25 to close at 152.45 kroons on turnover worth nine million kroons.
Union Bank shares worth 6.2 million kroons were traded and it ended one kroon higher at 45.20 kroons.
"Union Bank's price was supported by buying from Helsinki," another broker said.
Bluechip Hansapank closed 0.7 lower at 212.05 kroons on volume of four million kroons.
On the free market the volume was 5.5 million kroons.
The most traded stock was Rakvere Meat Plant which saw trade of 3.9 million kroons and ended 0.10 higher at 13.85 kroons.
Diversified industrial Norma lost 0.80 to close at 62.55 kroons. Shares worth one million kroons changed hands.
